explication: FastAPI is a Python ASGI framework for declaring typed API routes and serving validated requests with serialized responses. The main runtime path runs from an HTTP client through the application and router, into dependency resolution and parameter validation, then to user endpoint code and response encoding. Separate branches provide security dependencies, OpenAPI and interactive docs, middleware, WebSockets/SSE, and supporting response features. The graph follows the supplied tree, README, and sampled excerpts; unsampled subsystem links are omitted where their call wiring is not established.
